svg.title: ASESMA – African School on Electronic Structure Methods and Applications
svg.text: Supported by ICTP, NSF, APS & global partners
WHAT ASESMA IS & WHY IT MATTERS
ASESMA trains African researchers in computational material
science through biennial schools. Intensive lectures, hands-on
tutorials, and team projects on electronic structure, DFT, and
atomistic simulation methods. Across all Africani nations
(17 so far!). Building skills, lasting research networks, and
training talent to lead Africa's tech future.
ASESMA tutors and students at hands-on tutorials
Joined ASESMA as a graduate student in 2015 in search of a
community. Now professor of Physics and a leader of ASESMA.
ASESMA 2025 was held at his University of Ghana.
“The focused, collaborative nature of the ASESMA school was
one of its most valuable aspects.” Diana Keya, ASESMA 2025.
Learn · Compute · Collaborate · Build the next generation of African computational scientists
